primitives.name: Ball Position Determination
primitives.verbatim_quote: In mcasuring, the forward point of the ball, in its position when declared dead, not its center, sha!l be taken as the determining point.
primitives.assumptions: Ball is rigid; measurement occurs at time of death; forward point is defined by orientation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball is not in motion or is partially embedded.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic tracking kernel for dead-ball state estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Forward-point displacement from center during dead-ball state.

primitives.name: Drop Kick Mechanics
primitives.verbatim_quote: (a) A Drop-kick is made by letting the ball drop from the hands and kicking it the instant it rises from the ground.
primitives.assumptions: Instantaneous contact at rise; no air resistance; ball is released from rest.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball does not rise or is not caught mid-air.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's discrete-time impulse model for kick initiation.
layer2.telemetry: Kick initiation timing relative to ball-ground contact.

primitives.name: Place Kick Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) A Place-kick is made by kicking the ball after it has been placed on the ground.
primitives.assumptions: Ball is stationary on ground; kick is executed post-placement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When placement fails or kick is attempted before ground contact.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's grounded-state transition kernel for place-kick execution.
layer2.telemetry: Time between placement and kick initiation.
